regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the title and current Ir/Lewis-acid cooperative homocoupling claim. The abstract is an aggregate description, not an experiment-specific procedure or yield.
Classified the divergent-cooperative-catalysis concept and cited allenylic substitution chemistry as context. External literature was not promoted to current-paper experiments.
Figure 1 is a conceptual comparison of divergent and traditional cooperative catalysis; it contains no experiment-specific quantities or outcome and does not create a reaction row.

unresolved: Abstract/Figure 1 structures are generic and do not define unique experiment-specific charges or outcomes.

regions.finding: Separated the stated goal from two prior-work branches: Carreira-type Ir allenylic substitution and Trost vanadium cross-dienolate functionalization. These are literature examples, not experiments of this paper.
Classified the present divergent homocoupling as a general scheme with proposed cross-dienol and Ir-bound carbocation intermediates; concrete runs occur in Tables 1-2.
Classified ether, enone, aldol, and Michael branches as a competing-pathway mechanism map. No unprinted yields or observation status were assigned to G/H.
The prose provides literature/mechanistic rationale and no distinct current-paper run beyond the later optimization/control experiments.

unresolved: Generic R/R'/Nu/E groups do not define complete structures or conditions.
Scheme 2 is a possibility map and does not establish isolation of every branch product.

regions.region: page 3 upper prose continuation of Scheme 2
regions.finding: Confirmed that F/C/G/H are competing pathways used to motivate optimization; this prose does not create additional experiment rows.

regions.region: page 3 Table 1 reaction header, entries 1-14, and footnotes a-g
regions.finding: Recorded all fourteen optimization/control rows independently with shared 0.2 mmol 1a, catalyst/ligand/promoter loadings, 0.1 M/25 °C/10 h defaults, row promoter/solvent changes, entry-12 concentration override, entry-13 4 Å MS/36 h ether result, and entry-14 Cs2CO3 dose. NMR versus isolated yields and product-specific er values remain distinct.

regions.region: page 3 right-column optimization and scope narrative
regions.finding: Mapped prose no-reaction, byproduct, recovery, temperature, and scope statements to Table 1 and Table 2 records without duplicating the same experiments.

Entry 14 reports recovered 1a without a recovery percentage.
The source refers entry-7 yield calculation to unassociated SI; no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 4 full-width Table 2 reaction header, product grid, structures, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Recorded every displayed Table 2 condition/outcome separately: 22 standard product labels plus 2.0 mmol repeats for 2a/2e and the 5.8 mmol/2 mol% (Ra)-L ent-2r run. Shared 0.4 mmol, 0.1 M THF, 25 °C/10 h, isolated-yield/HPLC bases, 50 °C overrides, and >20:1 E/Z narrative are structured row-wise.
Retained aliphatic and tertiary allenylic-alcohol failure classes as unresolved main-text limitations because exact substrate rows, conversions, and enone yields are not supplied.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right scale-up, crystallography, and Scheme 3 introduction
regions.finding: Linked the 2a/2e/2r scale statements to their separate Table 2 rows, CCDC 2384042/R configuration to 2f, and the beginning 2a→5→6/2a→7 discussion to Scheme 3 records on page 5.

unresolved: Table 2 omits solvent volume, atmosphere, pre-chromatography workup, isolated masses, and E/Z analytical basis.

regions.region: page 5 upper full-width Scheme 3 arrows a-l and condition legend
regions.finding: Recorded eleven independent elaboration experiments. The 2a→5 51% result is retained as a two-step Luche-reduction/dehydration span; each remaining arrow has its own reagents, solvent, temperature/time program, yield, and selectivity. Printed 0–25 °C programs are timed transitions, not fabricated separate holds.
Mapped product-specific yields/selectivities and the unexpected 14→15 rearrangement to the arrow records. No duplicate prose experiments were created.
Linked the standard, 10 °C, 4 Å MS, and tertiary-alcohol 1w transposition controls to their page-6 arrows, preserving the figure/prose <5%-versus-not-detected difference for the molecular-sieve run.

unresolved: Scheme 3 generally omits scale, reagent amounts, solvent volumes, atmosphere, workup, purification, masses, yield bases, and some selectivity bases.
For 0–25 °C arrows the source does not separate addition, low-temperature hold, ramp, and final hold durations.
The 4 Å MS run prints <5% in Scheme 4A while prose says no 3a was detected.

regions.finding: Recorded four distinct Sc(OTf)3-only runs: 1a at 25 °C/48 h (71%), 1a at 10 °C/48 h (9%), 1a with 4 Å MS (<5% in figure/no 3a detected in prose), and 1w at 25 °C/24 h (76%). Ir catalyst is explicitly absent.
Recorded TBSCl capture without base (17 <5%, 3a 81%) separately from the NEt3-added run (62% recovered 1a, 17 <5%). The footnote reagent NEt3 and its 1.5 equiv dose are structured participants.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4C NMR monitoring and spectra
regions.finding: Recorded one in-tube 25 °C/CDCl3/0.1 M monitoring series with 5 min, 30 min, 8 h, 24 h, and 96 h observations and the two assigned cross-dienol doublets. Reference spectra of 3a/17 were not treated as charged reaction participants.
The prose interprets failed O-silylation, acid dependence, signal assignment, persistence, and E geometry; it enriches the Scheme 4 records and does not define additional reaction rows.

unresolved: Scheme 4 omits multiple absolute reagent masses/volumes, atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated masses, and analytical limits.
The NMR experiment does not quantify 18 or 3a and gives no integration/internal-standard basis.
Reference-spectrum provenance does not establish machine structure correctness.
